contexts.text: The reason why everyone contracted matrimony within the families. Explained. AC 483:end.
The celestial man (therefore) abhors matrimony with a number.
The reason why they were not to contract matrimonies with the daughters of the Canaanites. Explained. AC 8998.
When what is matrimonial is meant, (it) = conjunction.

Matrimony, which is here meant by betrothal, in the spiritual sense, is the conjunction of the life of one with that of the other. According to Divine order, it is conjunction of life from the truths of faith with life from the good of charity. Hence is all spiritual conjunction, from which as from its own origin natural conjunction comes forth.
(The limited choice that there is in contracting matrimony).
That there are external affections according to which matrimonies are commonly contracted in the world. General article.
But if the internal affections which conjoin minds are not in them, the matrimonies are dissolved in the house. General article.
Still, matrimonies in the world are to continue to the end of life. General article.
In matrimonies in which the internal affections do not conjoin, there are external ones which simulate internal ones, and consociate. General article.
For a spiritual man coupled in the matrimonial covenant with a natural one, intends nothing else than amendment of life...
That after the death of a consort again to contract matrimony depends upon the preceding conjugial love. Explained. CL 319, Explained.
That with those with whom there has not been love truly conjugial, nothing stands in the way of their contracting repeated matrimony. Explained.

With him who rejects all the matrimonial duty... when adultery is committed, Heaven is closed; because the matrimonial duty involves the Divine Heavenly, and the love of heavenly things; still more with a woman than with a man.
There are obscenities of speech, of thought, and of life (in Christian countries) which cause matrimonies to become vile, which yet are for the sake of the propagation of the human race.
In such matrimony (polygamy) there never can be conjugial love.
Without conscience injuring the matrimonial compact...
Contracting matrimony, and giving in wedlock () = to conjoin falsity with evil and evil with falsity.
